{{short description|American chemist}}

'''Richard Hays Boyd''' (August 12, 1929 – December 28, 2016) was an American [[chemist]]. He was a [[distinguished professor]] at the [[University of Utah]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://academic-affairs.utah.edu/awards-nominations/distinguished-professor/|title=Distinguished Professor|work=[[University of Utah]]|access-date=October 25, 2026}}</ref> and he was named a [[List of fellows of the American Physical Society|fellow]] of the [[American Physical Society]] in 1980.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aps.org/funding-recognition/aps-fellowship?q=richard%20h%20boyd&af=true|title=APS Fellow Archive|work=[[American Physical Society]]|access-date=October 25, 2026}}</ref>

Boyd died from [[Alzheimer's disease]] on December 28, 2016, at the age of 87.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.legacy.com/us/obituaries/dispatch/name/richard-boyd-obituary?id=18764300|title=Richard Boyd Obituary (1929-2016)|work=[[The Columbus Dispatch]]|date=January 9, 2017|access-date=October 25, 2026|via=[[Legacy.com]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ulink.utah.edu/s/1077/16/interior.aspx?sid=1077&gid=1&calcid=8628&calpgid=2397&pgid=2401&crid=0|title=In Memoriam|work=[[University of Utah]]|access-date=October 25, 2026}}</ref>
